pages.text: A dose D into a volume V gives a level D/V that falls by first-order clearance, C = (D/V).e^(-kt), half gone every ln(2)/k. Dosed every interval, the level settles into a band; it must stay above what works and below what harms.
$(thing)Set$(): Dose, Interval.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Sticky valve: the level varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too little between doses: it does nothing; Too much: a toxic peak.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): More frequent dosing is faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Peak level: C_max = (D/V) / (1 - e^(-k.tau))$(br)Trough level: C_min = C_max.e^(-k.tau)
